questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and fourth number is related to third number:

5 ∶ 127 ∶∶ 6 ∶ 218 ∶∶ 3 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number)³ + 2 = 2nd number.**

Now,

For, 5 : 127

⇒ (5)³ + 2

⇒ 125 + 2 = 127.

For,

6 : 218

⇒ (6)³ + 2

⇒ 216 + 2 = 218.

Similarly, for** 3 : ? **

**⇒ (3)³ + 2 **

**⇒ 27 + 2 = 29.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"29"**.

**Option 1) - and =**

Given: 63 = 56 + 88 ÷ 11 - 15

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given equation?

× and + ; 24 × 8 + 6 ÷ 3 - 18
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given: 24 × 8 + 6 ÷ 3 - 18

After interchanging '× and +' we get;

⇒ 24 + 8 × __**6 ÷ 3**__ - 18

⇒ 24 + __**8 × **2__ - 18

⇒ __**24 + 16**__ - 18

⇒ **__40 - 18__** = 22.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some B are A.

II. No C is B.

**Conclusion:**

I. No C is A.

II. No B is C.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:

I. Some B are A.

II. No C is B.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eb4b8dd8a588e29c188cb166769fb2a368edf4e228a14d9cc2d1f8165728251.png] 

 

Conclusions:

I. No C is A - False (Because, No definite relation given between C and A, so it can be possible only).

II. No B is C - True (Because, No C is B, so No B is C).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (∶∶) are related with each other by some Iogic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (∶∶) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Rodent ∶ Rat ∶∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic**: Category : Example**.

Rodent : Rat → A **Rat **is a type of **Rodent**.

Similarly,

Crockery : Cup → A **Cup **is a type of **Crockery**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Crockery : Cup"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Man : Mammal" is incorrect because while a man is indeed a type of mammal, the relation does not align exactly with the question as "mammal" is a more broad category than "rodent".
 
• 
 
• "Pen : Stationery" is also incorrect because while a pen is a type of stationery, it is not the perfect match as the category of stationery includes many other items too, and the word "pen" represents an item, not a category.
 
• "Reptile : Elephant" is clearly incorrect because an elephant is a mammal, not a reptile.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers shares the same relationship in set as that shared by the numbers in the given set. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(12, 60, 5)

(14, 56, 4)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number × 3rd number) = 2nd number.**

Now,

For, (12, 60, 5)

⇒ 12 × 5 = 60.

For, (14, 56, 4)

⇒ 14 × 4 = 56.

Now, using this logic for the provided options, we find:

 
• 
 
(7, 70, 8) ⇒ 7 × 8 = 56 ≠ 70.

 
 
• 
 
(20, 5, 7) ⇒ 20 × 7 = 140 ≠ 5.

 
 
• 
 
**(10, 100, 10) ⇒ 10 × 10 = 100.**

 
 
• 
 
(4, 20, 8) ⇒ 4 × 8 = 32 ≠ 20.

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. Price of J is less than U, M and N. Price of B is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of U is less than M. Price of neither U nor M is the highest. Price of how many cars is less than the price of M?
questions.solution:
Given: Five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared.

1) Price of B is the least.

__ > __ > __ > __ > B

2) Price of J is less than U, M and N.

__ > __ > __ > J > B

3) Price of U is less than M.

M > U

4) Price of neither U nor M is the highest - It means N has the highest price.

So, the final arrangement will be:

N > M > U > J > B

So, Price of '**three**' cars is less than the price of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
